## Verification

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] Fast tests pass
- [ ] Both production builds pass
- [ ] Browser playthrough passes, or the reason it is not applicable is recorded
- [ ] A Cloudflare preview was checked on the target devices for player-facing work
- [ ] Balance and campaign gates pass if simulation, schemas, or game data changed
- [ ] New third-party assets or dependencies have recorded provenance and compatible terms
- [ ] Save-format changes include migration and recovery coverage
